mentions.name: TTZ
mentions.description: A next-generation terminal protocol that cleanly separates text and commands to remove legacy cruft. The protocol is defined with a couple of implementations ready, and it already supports pictures, vector graphics, and file and audio streaming for building richer terminal UIs.
mentions.problem: Programming and developing UIs against the standard terminal protocols is frustrating due to legacy cruft.
mentions.source_excerpt: TTZ: A sort of next-gen protocol for terminals. The basic idea is to create a dedicated terminal protocol that allows for more features and less legacy cruft (text and commands are cleanly separated). Right now, I’ve defined the protocol and have a couple of implementations ready. It already supports pictures, vector graphics, and file and audio streaming.
